hook: Your map hides a country that is landlocked twice.
title: The country that is landlocked twice
description:
Liechtenstein only touches Switzerland and Austria, and both of them are landlocked too. That makes it doubly landlocked: you cross two borders to reach a country with a coast. Only one other country is in the same position, Uzbekistan. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Liechtenstein #Geography
comment_prompt: Could you live landlocked? Yes or no
